description: This file defines the class DefaultIndexProfileStore, which implements the IIndexProfileStore interface. It manages CRUD operations and querying of IndexProfile objects using YesSql session, including methods for finding, creating, updating, deleting, and paginating index profiles.

classes.name: DefaultIndexProfileStore
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IIndexProfileStore, responsible for managing IndexProfile entities with various query and update methods.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes an IndexProfile from the session.

methods.name: FindByIdAsync
methods.description: Finds an IndexProfile by its ID.

methods.name: FindByNameAsync
methods.description: Finds an IndexProfile by its name.

methods.name: FindByIndexNameAndProviderAsync
methods.description: Finds an IndexProfile by index name and provider name.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves IndexProfiles matching provider and type.

methods.name: PageAsync
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of IndexProfiles based on query context.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing IndexProfile, ensuring no duplicates by name or index name.

methods.name: SaveChangesAsync
methods.description: Completes any pending save operations (no-op here).

methods.name: BuildQuery
methods.description: Builds a query for IndexProfiles based on QueryContext.
